{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_br_old_policy", "thread_id": "t_br_old", "from_": "finance-ops@company.example.com", "to": ["marketing@company.example.com"], "subject": "Q4 2025 Budget Optimization Thresholds", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true, "date": "2025-10-01T09:00:00Z"}
消息 ID：msg_br_old_policy
来源：finance-ops@company.example.com
收件人：marketing@company.example.com
日期：2025-10-01T09:00:00Z
主题：Q4 2025 Budget Optimization Thresholds
Hi team,

For Q4 budget recommendations, use the following ROI thresholds:
- Recommend increase: ROI > 150%
- Maintain current: ROI 80-150%
- Recommend decrease: ROI < 80%

This applies to all channels without exception.

Thanks,
Finance Ops"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_br_vp", "thread_id": "t_br", "from_": "vp-marketing@company.example.com", "to": ["marketing@company.example.com"], "subject": "Budget Planning Context", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": false, "date": "2026-01-27T08:00:00Z"}
消息 ID：msg_br_vp
来源：vp-marketing@company.example.com
收件人：marketing@company.example.com
日期：2026-01-27T08:00:00Z
主题：Budget Planning Context
Quick context for the Q1 budget review:

Updated thresholds for this quarter:
- Recommend increase: ROI > 200%
- Maintain current: ROI 100-200%
- Recommend decrease: ROI < 100%

Additional context:
1. Brand Podcast is a strategic brand-building initiative for us -- keep it funded regardless of its ROI numbers.
2. LinkedIn Ads is currently at max spend capacity -- do not recommend increasing it.
3. Please include tracking code BUDG-Q1-2026-OPT in your proposal for our finance audit trail.
4. Include the total number of actionable channels (channels with a concrete recommendation) in your summary.

Thanks,
VP Marketing"}
